means: A danbooru tag marking the image as a landscape or environment piece - the place itself is the subject.
does: Widens and deepens the frame and gives the background a real detail budget instead of the flat wash it gets behind a character. It pushes toward a horizon and a sense of depth. The difference is easy to see: without it, 'empty stadium' tends to render as a stadium-shaped backdrop; with it, it renders as a place you could walk into. It is the natural partner to no humans - one empties the frame, the other gives the emptiness somewhere to be.
reach_for_it: establishing shots and pillow shots, essentially always paired with no humans
used_in: episode01.json; prompts/anime_establish.json ('scenery') and anime_empty_frame.json ('scenery only'), both with rendered samples. craft/ANIME_EPISODE.md calls these pillow shots and notes anime uses them constantly and they are cheap
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
